from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    upper=[]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(sep):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] and (r,c) not in seen:
                color=grid[r][c]
                stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
                while stack:
                    rr,cc=stack.pop(); comp.append((rr,cc))
                    for nr,nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                        if 0 <= nr < sep and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                            seen.add((nr,nc)); stack.append((nr,nc))
                upper.append((color,comp))
    # The rightmost upper object is the one carried forward.
    color, comp=max(upper, key=lambda item:max(c for r,c in item[1]))
    lower=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(sep+1,h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]]
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(9)]
    # Lower figure keeps its horizontal position; deleting the six-row divider gap shifts it upward by six.
    for r,c,v in lower:
        out[r-6][c]=v
    rmin=min(r for r,c in comp); cmin=min(c for r,c in comp)
    rmax=max(r for r,c in comp); cmax=max(c for r,c in comp)
    lrmin=min(r for r,c,v in lower); lcmin=min(c for r,c,v in lower); lcmax=max(c for r,c,v in lower)
    top_r=lrmin-6-(rmax-rmin)-1
    target_center=(lcmin+lcmax)/2
    source_center=(cmin+cmax)/2
    dc=round(target_center-source_center)
    dr=top_r-rmin
    for r,c in comp:
        out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
    return out
